_comment: Policy for the weekly external URL check (.github/workflows/external-links.yml,
The timeout and retry budget are deliberately small: with four files checked in
parallel, a throttling host must cost seconds, not minutes.
ignorePatterns cover URLs that are placeholders or unreachable by design.
aliveStatusCodes treats 403 and 429 as alive: they prove the host answered,
and several sites Doctrine cites (HHS, OpenAI, Stack Overflow, MySQL docs,
lib.rs, docs.ansible.com) refuse or throttle CI user agents. Failing on them
would make the gate a coin toss rather than a signal about Doctrine.
